actions.name: Partner's Step

actions.name: Bloodied Courtier
actions.description: Below 55 HP, Crimson Rapier deals +1d6 necrotic damage.

actors.name: Volenta — Oathbreaker Bride of the Mask
actors.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/02 — Brides & Finn

biography.value:
☾ ◆ ☽

Volenta — Oathbreaker Bride of the Mask

Volenta is the male bride Madam Eva described: a fallen paladin who does not gorge on victims. He chooses them, seduces or dominates them, and drains them slowly over months. In combat he is the patient martial counterweight to Anastrasya: black plate, broken vows, punishing smites, control auras and deliberate pressure on isolated targets.

He should feel like someone who has had centuries to turn chivalry into predation.

☾ ◆ ☽

actions.name: Black Oath Blade
actions.description: Two measured greatsword attacks. The necrotic damage represents Volenta’s broken oath feeding each strike.

actions.name: Sanguine Smite — Recharge 5–6
actions.description: After the attack hits, Volenta may expend the recharge to add the necrotic dice. If the target is frightened, charmed or isolated from all allies by 10 feet or more, it also cannot regain hit points until the start of Volenta’s next turn.

actions.name: Dreadful Aspect — 1/Encounter
actions.description: Creatures of Volenta’s choice within 30 feet that can see him must save or become Frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn. Artifact sunlight grants advantage on this save.

actions.name: Months, Not Minutes
actions.description: Volenta fixes one creature within 30 feet with the intimate certainty of a predator who believes time belongs to him. On a failure the target takes the psychic damage, cannot benefit from advantage against Volenta, and Volenta always knows its direction while both remain in Ravenloft until the end of his next turn.

actions.name: Broken Vow Aura
actions.description: Hostile creatures that begin their turn within 10 feet of Volenta cannot take reactions until the start of their next turn unless they succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom save. A creature that succeeds is immune to the aura until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Unholy Intercession
actions.description: When Anastrasya or another allied vampire within 30 feet is hit, Volenta may move up to half his speed toward the attacker without provoking. If he ends within reach, he may impose disadvantage on the next attack that creature makes before the end of its next turn.

features.name: Veil of the Black Sun
features.description: Ordinary sunlight and Daylight do not trigger vampire sunlight weaknesses. Artifact-grade sunlight suppresses the Veil: while exposed, Volenta takes 15 radiant damage at the start of his turn, cannot regenerate, cannot enter mist-form escape, and cannot use Ravenloft wall-phasing until the start of his next turn. A successful DC 18 Dispel Magic ability check suppresses the Veil until the start of the caster’s next turn.

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.description: Volenta’s weapon attacks already include the offensive benefit of his corrupted oath. Do not add another flat Charisma damage bonus unless the encounter needs emergency tuning.

features.name: Vampiric Resilience
features.description: Use the campaign’s normal vampire resistances and weaknesses as appropriate. This module replaces only the sunlight interaction through Veil of the Black Sun.

actions.name: Nightglass Step

actors.name: Orcus — Manifestation of the Death Lord
actors.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/04 — Dark Powers & Manifestations

biography.value:
☾ ◆ ☽

Orcus — Manifestation of the Death Lord

A newly freed Dark Power made corporeal by the collapse of the Amber prison. Orcus does not come to rescue the Unkindness. He comes to collect what centuries of denied death have accumulated around Strahd.

☾ ◆ ☽

actions.name: Skull-Mace of the Manifestation
actions.description: Against a fiend, add 2d8 force to one hit each turn. This is why the contracted pit fiend treats Orcus as the immediate enemy.

actions.name: Word of Unmaking
actions.description: Recharge 5–6. 60-foot cone. Half on success. A creature that fails cannot regain hit points until the beginning of Orcus’s next turn.

actions.name: Soul Hook
actions.description: One resurrected creature, soul-coin bearer, or creature returned from death within 60 feet is chained to the grave. On failure it is Restrained until it or an ally uses an action to break the hook (AC 18, 20 HP) or succeeds on a DC 18 Charisma check at the end of its turn.

actions.name: Call the Recently Dead
actions.description: Choose a corpse, destroyed undead, or grave within 60 feet. It erupts as a deathless obstacle or 20-foot necrotic hazard until the end of Orcus’s next turn. Do not add a full extra monster unless pacing needs it.

actions.name: Horned Advance
actions.description: Bonus Action. Move up to half speed toward Strahd, Vampyr, or the pit fiend without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Dark Power Reconstitution — Wish Required
features.description: Before the Edict of Finality is created by Wish, reducing this manifestation to 0 HP does not defeat Orcus. At the end of the next round he reforms at 115 HP from the nearest Grave Horn or from the death-soaked fabric of Ravenloft, Orcus Pressure increases by 1, and one destroyed Grave Horn may reform. Show this once; after the lesson is learned, do not force the table to grind the same impossible health bar repeatedly. A final banish/spare/bargain result is locked until Wish changes the law.

features.name: Death Lord’s Priority
features.description: Orcus wants Strahd permanently dead so he can seize the soul and the death-energy of Barovia. He attacks the contracted pit fiend when it interferes, then the Unkindness if they deny him his prize.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (2)
features.description: The manifestation may choose to succeed on two failed saving throws during the entire Ravenloft finale.

features.name: Edict of Finality
features.description: Once the Wish has made the Edict active, Orcus can no longer reconstitute in Barovia. Destroyed Grave Horns stay destroyed. Reaching 0 HP creates a real ending choice: banish the manifestation, permit withdrawal, or bargain. This does not erase the true cosmic Orcus from existence.

actors.name: Vampyr — Manifestation of the First Thirst
actors.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/04 — Dark Powers & Manifestations

biography.value:
☾ ◆ ☽

Vampyr — Manifestation of the First Thirst

The broken covenant answers Thorgrinn’s blow with hatred. Vampyr arrives as blood climbing upward through Ravenloft’s walls and a red eclipse over the castle, seeking to reclaim Strahd or choose the next vessel itself.

☾ ◆ ☽

actions.name: Bloodlash
actions.description: A hit may pull the target up to 15 feet toward a blood pool, Strahd, or one of Vampyr’s covenant tethers.

actions.name: First Thirst
actions.description: Vampyr drinks blood, life-force, or soul resonance; constructs and soul-coin vessels are not exempt. Vampyr regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage actually dealt.

actions.name: Night Without Stars
actions.description: Recharge 5–6. The battlefield becomes supernatural night until initiative 10 next round. Ordinary light fails. Artifact sunlight remains as a narrow cutting radiance. This is Legna’s prophecy trigger: a silent raven reveals the path to the hidden blood anchor.

actions.name: Covenant Hook
actions.description: Attach a blood tether to Strahd, Finn, Tatyana, Damien, or another creature whose story is entangled with vampirism. Three active Hooks on Strahd when he reaches 0 HP allow Vampyr to attempt to rebind him instead of letting him die. Each Hook is AC 18, 20 HP and can be severed by artifact sunlight.

actions.name: Red Mist Step
actions.description: Bonus Action. Teleport up to 40 feet between blood, mist, a vampire, or a Ravenloft shadow.

features.name: Dark Power Reconstitution — Wish Required
features.description: Before the Edict of Finality is created by Wish, reducing this manifestation to 0 HP does not defeat Vampyr. At the end of the next round it reforms at 103 HP from the nearest Blood Heart, a vampire, or Strahd’s spilled blood; Vampyr Claim increases by 1 and one destroyed Blood Heart may reform. Show this once; after the rule is understood, do not make the party repeat an unwinnable grind. A final banish/spare/bargain result is locked until Wish changes the law.

features.name: Vindictive First Thirst
features.description: Vampyr remembers Thorgrinn shattering its Amber prison and calls him “metal dwarf.” It does not primarily want Strahd dead; it wants the covenant, the humiliation, and the right to decide what Strahd becomes next.

features.name: Artifact Sunlight Vulnerability
features.description: Artifact sunlight suppresses Red Mist Step and Covenant Hook reactions until the start of Vampyr’s next turn. Vampyr takes 20 radiant damage when it begins its turn in artifact sunlight.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (2)
features.description: The manifestation may choose to succeed on two failed saving throws during the entire Ravenloft finale.

features.name: Edict of Finality
features.description: Once the Wish has made the Edict active, Vampyr cannot re-form its manifestation inside dying Barovia. Destroyed Blood Hearts remain destroyed and Strahd cannot be rebound by the old covenant. At 0 HP Vampyr can finally be banished, allowed to withdraw, or bargained with.

features.name: Recognition, Not Future Service
features.description: The party rejected a future favour. Arl instead receives truthful written recognition that his assistance materially aided the defeat of Strahd. No souls and no future service are owed.

features.name: Priority: Orcus
features.description: Once Orcus manifests, Arl treats the demon/Dark Power as the most offensive corruption on the battlefield and naturally focuses it unless the players order otherwise.

actors.name: Rudolph van Richten — Final Briefing

The hunter who reconstructed members of the Unkindness through soul-coin vessels. He is their final technical counsel before Ravenloft and remains in Vallaki to keep civilians alive.

actions.name: Monster Hunter’s Diagnosis

actions.name: Emergency Field Medicine
actions.description: Once per scene, stabilize a creature and restore 3d8+5 HP using prepared reagents.

features.name: The Locks Are Open
features.description: Van Richten understands that the Amber Temple’s broken prisons have changed the magical ecology. He knows cult symbols are now being answered by something external.

features.name: Not Omniscient
features.description: He can infer anchors, inheritance and Wish-scale reality magic, but he cannot prove the exact rules until Orcus/Vampyr demonstrate reconstitution.

actors.name: Saraphene — Shadar-kai Vampire Messenger
actors.folder: The Cat and the Unkindness/00 — Current Session / Vallaki

biography.value:
☾ ◆ ☽

Saraphene — Shadar-kai Vampire Messenger

The shaved-headed vampire who delivered Strahd’s sealed invitation on the road. She warned that the castle is on full alert, Finn returned injured, Tatyana is protected, the brides are divided, and something important has been moved into one of Ravenloft’s three towers.
☾ ◆ ☽

actions.name: Shadow Blade
actions.description: Saraphene is dangerous but has explicitly asked not to fight the Unkindness.

actions.name: Mist Escape
actions.description: Transform into mist and withdraw from a scene unless artifact sunlight prevents it.

actions.name: Court Gossip
actions.description: If Saraphene reappears, she can reveal one current argument, patrol relocation, or bride fear inside Ravenloft rather than joining combat.

features.name: Survival First
features.description: Saraphene hates Strahd and wants to survive. She is not good and never claimed to be.

features.name: Shadowfell Origin
features.description: She identified herself as Shadar-kai before vampirism and has served Strahd for roughly eighty years.
